You are editing the Kotlin Multiplatform client. Read `app/AGENTS.md` before making changes — it
covers the module map, MVVM/Compose/Koin conventions, and the KMP rules for what may live in
`commonMain` vs a platform source set.

Then read the `AGENTS.md` in the specific module you are touching (e.g.
`app/core/user/AGENTS.md`, `app/feature/issues/impl/AGENTS.md`). Each documents that module's
responsibilities and public API.
